name: The Missing Shipment
summary: In Ratchet, Gazlowe waits for goods sent from Booty Bay across the Great Sea. He sends couriers to Wharfmaster Dizzywig to check the dock records, while the Southsea Freebooters remain a possible cause of the delay.

sections.title: Ratchet's Vital Lifeline
sections.body: Ratchet is the Steamwheedle Cartel's trading port on Kalimdor. Ships cross the Great Sea from Booty Bay with manufactured goods, exotic supplies, and heavy freight for the town's building and trade. When cargo goes missing, business suffers. Chief Engineer Gazlowe keeps close track of every crate brought into port.

sections.title: Cross-Referencing the Cargo
sections.body: The Southsea Freebooters haunt the coast south of Ratchet and often intercept merchant ships. Gazlowe checks his records before accusing the pirates or sending anyone into a fight. He sends his inventory ledger to Wharfmaster Dizzywig at the docks. Dizzywig oversees the unloading and storage of ship cargo, and can check whether goods were lost at sea or misplaced in a warehouse.

faq.q: What is in the missing shipment?
faq.answer: Gazlowe speaks of vital goods from Booty Bay, but Wharfmaster Dizzywig thinks the chief engineer is fretting over a custom order of boots from Drizzlek.
Wharfmaster Dizzywig oversees shipping records on Ratchet's docks. He manages cargo transfers between ships crossing the ocean and local warehouses for the Steamwheedle Cartel.

faq.q: Why does Gazlowe suspect the Southsea Freebooters?
faq.answer: The Southsea Freebooters have camps along the Merchant Coast, just south of Ratchet. They prey on trade routes between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, making them suspects when merchant cargo disappears.
The shipment came from Booty Bay, the goblin port at the southern tip of Stranglethorn Vale in the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: What happens after giving the ledger to Dizzywig?
faq.answer: Dizzywig compares his shipping records with Gazlowe's ledger to see whether the cargo reached Ratchet's warehouses or was seized before unloading.

faq.q: Why doesn't Gazlowe check the docks himself?
faq.answer: As Ratchet's Chief Engineer and leader, Gazlowe runs town affairs and expansion projects from his central office. He prefers to pay traveling adventurers to carry paperwork across town.

angles.text: Gazlowe's need for spare parts, exotic imports, and custom gear from Booty Bay shows the difficulty of keeping Ratchet's machinery running far from goblin industrial centers.
Ratchet remains neutral and offers Horde travelers a port between Kalimdor and Stranglethorn Vale. Trade at its docks matters to both.
